reviews.name: Sandeep Kamath
reviews.text:
I have been using Sidhi Elder Care Services for over four months now, and I cannot recommend them highly enough.
They have supported my family through hospital admissions, doctor visits, and follow-up care, including managing prescribed medications for both my mother and my sister. For all of the above, I would rate them very highly.
What stands out most is their reliability and punctuality. They arrange pick-up for elder care patients by Uber, and they are consistently on time, organized, and caring. It has given our entire family complete peace of mind knowing our loved ones are in safe, capable hands.
If you are looking for trustworthy elder care support, Sidhi is exceptional. Highly recommended
